Interactive data table

Source: R/data-table.R
shad_data_table.Rd

A shadcn-styled data table: client-side multi-sort (Shift+click), global and per-column filtering, windowed pagination, row selection, and column visibility, rendered from a data frame. It is a bound Shiny input: input$<inputId> is a list with selected (row keys), sort, filter, page, and pageSize. Only the current page is in the DOM, so it stays responsive to a few thousand rows; for larger or server-computed data push new rows with update_shad_data_table().

Usage

shad_data_table(
  inputId,
  data,
  columns = NULL,
  row_key = NULL,
  selection = c("none", "single", "multiple"),
  filter = c("none", "global", "columns", "both"),
  page_size = 10,
  page_sizes = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
  sortable = TRUE,
  column_visibility = FALSE,
  sticky_header = FALSE,
  max_height = "24rem",
  empty = "No results.",
  filter_placeholder = "Filter rows...",
  columns_label = "Columns",
  page_size_label = "Rows per page",
  loading = FALSE,
  width = NULL,
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

inputId

Input id.

data

A data frame (or object coercible with as.data.frame()).

columns

Optional named list of shad_col() specs, keyed by column name. Columns without a spec use type-based defaults.

row_key

Optional column name providing stable row identities. NULL uses the row index.

selection

"none" (default), "single", or "multiple".

filter

"none" (default), "global", "columns", or "both".

page_size

Initial rows per page.

page_sizes

Selectable page sizes.

sortable

Master switch for column sorting (per-column overridable in shad_col()).

column_visibility

Show the column-visibility dropdown.

sticky_header

Freeze the header and scroll the body within max_height.

max_height

Viewport height when sticky_header = TRUE.

empty

Text or tags shown when there are no rows.

filter_placeholder

Placeholder for the global filter input.

columns_label, page_size_label

Labels for the column-visibility trigger and page-size select.

loading

If TRUE, render skeleton rows until update_shad_data_table() supplies data.

width

CSS width.

class

Extra CSS classes.

...

Extra attributes on the root.

Value

A data-table tag, bound as a Shiny input.

Details

Row identity comes from row_key (a column of stable ids) or the 1-based row index. Selection is reported as these keys.

See also

Other shadshiny data table: shad_col(), shad_data_table_server(), shad_fmt, update_shad_data_table()

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  shad_data_table(
    "tbl", head(mtcars),
    selection = "multiple", filter = "global",
    columns = list(mpg = shad_col("MPG", format = shad_fmt_number(1)))
  )
}
